name: terminal-unique
$comment: unique over a full-arity eq narrowed to exactly one row: compile_collect_terminal uses LIMIT 2 and the executor errors PRECONDITION_FAILED only when >1 row matches; 0/1 rows shape the result as Doc(Some/None) — the doc OBJECT itself. take/order are absent because UNIQUE_PEERS rejects them alongside distinct/aggregate; index/eq remain legal.
